mentions.name: jobswithgpt
mentions.description: A job search site that focuses on listings posted directly by companies, with no spam, middlemen, or sponsored posts. It uses AI to surface better matches, recommend jobs intelligently, and automatically extract the most important information from job listings. Users can bookmark and track jobs without signup; personalized suggestions require an account. A crawler discovers new jobs as they are posted, though not in real time.
mentions.problem: Job boards are cluttered with spam, middlemen, and bloated sponsored posts that drown out real opportunities for job seekers.
mentions.source_excerpt: I’ve been working on a side project called jobswithgpt — after months of building and refining, the first version is finally live: https://jobswithgpt.com
